content.text: {"affected_statement":"L3.2","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"lemma","explanation":"The quoted sweep argument does not justify its key induction hypothesis. Knowing that two nonnegative uncancelled totals sum to T-d does not imply that each is at most (T-d)/2; that would force equality, which is neither stated nor proved. The block-count and parity-contribution assertions are likewise unsupported. Section 4 merely invokes Lemma (i), so no independent universal Xiang construction appears elsewhere. Establishing L3.2 therefore requires a substantive completed lemma or another universal upper-bound argument, not a symbolic or one-sentence repair."}
